body.zh: 起点。虚礼典礼官 Meg 的主账房——你学会「先听，再动」的地方；调音桩歇气存档都在这。地平线很平，钟声是被压下去的，不是没有。
body.en: Origin. The Valet-Master-of-the-Ledger Meg’s counting house — where you learn to listen before you move; every peg rest and save lives here. The bell is pressed down, not absent.

body.zh: 频率罗盘的回声。树只认你的心跳——大声走会叫醒整片林子；按 V 屏息穿过。音程 ♭F。
body.en: An echo of the Frequency Compass. The trees only know your heartbeat — sprint and they all wake; hold V to breathe and pass. Key of ♭F.

body.zh: 水声压过钟声。水下有一口从没被敲响的钟，也有一句被泡软的碑文——先听低频，别急着断水上来。音程 ♭A。
body.en: Water covers the bell with its own hush. A bell no one ever struck waits below, with an inscription softened to a wash — follow the lows, surface later. Key of ♭A.

body.zh: 残刃的营。Brute 在这守桥；这里不是测伤害的地方，是练「痛之后还能站住」的地方。音程 ♭C。
body.en: The Brute’s ground, holding the bridge. Not where damage is measured — where “stand back up” is practiced. Key of ♭C.

body.zh: 序幕：奥斯塔拉（钟壳，三阶段，P1 只吃 10%）。四层钟脸，一根断裂的鸣弦。她的「先敲一下，再说抱歉」只会在你站到最高处之后说。音程 ♭D。
body.en: Overture: Ostlara, the Bell-Shell — three phases, P1 takes only 10%. Four tiers of faces, one snapped cord. Her “struck first, then apologized” comes only after you reach the top. Key of ♭D.

body.zh: 隐藏 Boss：万籁 The Myriad。她不看、只听——按 V 把噪音压到地板以下，你就是被风刮走的那张纸。音程 ♭G。
body.en: The hidden boss: The Myriad. She does not see, she hears — hold V to press your noise below the floor and drift like a scrap of paper. Key of ♭G.

body.zh: 终章：恩希尔 Hersil。先拆指挥棒，再逐小节闪避每一个 3/4； Ending 由你这一记敲出来的话决定。音程 ♭B。
body.en: Final: Hersil. Break the baton first, then ride his 3/4 — every downbeat is yours. Which ending you speak now is the one the world keeps. Key of ♭B.

body.zh: Encore（EPIC-V）。Epilogue 之后第一片新海——风是带钟的风，却从不肯让你听清。无 Boss、无 NPC 登记，只有三段话等你去走。
body.en: Encore (EPIC-V). The first new shore after the Epilogue — a wind that carries bells but never lets you hear them. No boss, no NPC registered; three sentences wait for you.

body.zh: 序幕 Boss。三阶段：P1 钟壳只吃 10%——别硬破，保住状态；P2 裂开内衬；P3 直面她本人。她的护甲是「钟壳」，不是物理壳——打脸之前先攒够足够多的余音。
body.en: The opener. Three phases: P1 takes 10% — don’t grind, save state; P2 the lining splits; P3 her, directly. The shell is not armor, it’s a thesis — carry enough resonance before you touch her.

body.zh: 隐藏 Boss。她不看，只听——你的每一次脚步都是名片。V 键屏息不只是「更安静」，是她唯一的攻击判定里唯一的解。她的安全带，就是你的呼吸线。
body.en: The hidden one. She doesn’t see — she hears. Every footstep is your calling card. V is not “quieter”, it is the only defense in her single attack pattern. Your breathing line is your seatbelt.

body.zh: 终章 Boss。她/他把「指挥棒」举得比任何人都高。先破指挥棒（首要目标），再在 3/4 小节边界闪避——每一记 downbeat 落地前那帧都是你的。
body.en: The finale. The baton is raised higher than anyone else’s. Break it first (priority target), then dodge on 3/4 bar lines — every frame before the downbeat lands is yours.

title.zh: 结局一 · 敲响第四口钟
title.en: Ending I · Sound the fourth bell

body.zh: 钟回，世界回响——她终于得到那段缺了大半辈子的话。叙事主线最常见的走向；余响给「正音」。
body.en: The bell returns; the world breathes again — she finally gets the missing sentence. The most walked path; the coda grants “True Pitch”.

title.zh: 结局二 · 交给她熔掉
title.en: Ending II · Give it to her to melt

body.zh: 她熔了第四口钟——世界回到「只有敲一下」的工坊安静。钟不响了，但「那一记」仍然被记账。
body.en: She melts the fourth bell — the workshop returns to a one-strike quiet. The bell never rings again, yet the ledger still records that single toll.

title.zh: 结局三 · 永远不再触摸

body.zh: 钟永远悬着——你选了沉默，也是有代价的：这个世界会再沉一次。没有人追责你，钟只是悬在那。
body.en: The bell hangs forever — you chose silence, and the price is hearing the world hush itself once more. No one holds you accountable; it just hangs there.

body.zh: 恩希尔倒下之后，世界没有立刻亮灯——「余响归位」这条七线之后的巡礼线由石版人发起：走过所有见证过的战场，把「最后一句」陆续归位。
body.en: After Hersil falls, the world doesn’t flip a switch — the seventh questline, “The Afterglow”, begins at the stone tablet; it walks you back through every witness, returning the last sentence, one by one.

title.zh: 止音纪元 The silenced epoch

body.zh: 钟敲了又开始安静了的纪元。所有钟应当在线但已灭——本作的一切紧张都来自这句：沉默是罪，声音是亏。
body.en: The epoch where every bell rang and then the quiet returned. All bells were meant to remain online; they did not. The tension of this work, in one line: silence is the crime, sound is the debt.

body.zh: 纪元初始被鸣的那一记——也就是玩家入此世的原因。它的余音从未真正离开；玩家出场时，世界仍然在听它。
body.en: The opening toll of the epoch — the reason players arrive in this world at all. Its resonance never truly left; the world is still listening when you enter.

body.zh: 杀死 Boss 后的余弦微粒渲染——不是粒子效果，是音程。每一位留一根弦（♭E/♭F/♭A/♭C/♭D/♭G/♭B），谱册里的「乐章」为此而来。
body.en: The cosine-residue render left by every defeated boss — not particles, pitch. Each leaves one string (♭E/♭F/♭A/♭C/♭D/♭G/♭B); the “Moves” page exists for this.

body.zh: Whisperwode 在指引方向时所用频率——玩家在雾里找路的那根看不见的线。它不指路，它「共鸣」。
body.en: The frequency Whisperwode uses to point. The invisible string that guides you through fog. It doesn’t point; it resonates.

title.zh: 带耳朵走 Walk with ears

body.zh: 每一个获取的声音（音色石）都被自动录入，结束即退回——玩家永远不需要显式「听」。一切挂载都是默默完成的耳朵。
body.en: Every acquired voice (resonance stones) is auto-recorded and returned at the end — you never explicitly “listen”. Every attachment is an ear, diligently doing its work in the dark.

title.zh: 敲不碎的铃 The unbreakable bell

body.zh: 科温怀中之物——未碎之钟（item: it_resonance_core）。它是为「只有一敲是真的」那个人准备的，不是为胜利准备的。
body.en: Corvin’s keepsake — the unbroken bell (item: it_resonance_core). It was made for the one who believes only one toll is true — not for victory.

title.zh: 我等之石 The stone that waits

body.zh: 终章那「唯一不响的石」—— HERSIL 的碑文。它不是威胁；它是「沉默不是空白，是等待」的证明。
body.en: The single unringing stone of the finale — HERSIL’s inscription. Not a threat; proof that silence isn’t blank — it’s waiting.

body.zh: 终末大殿，所有钟的余响在此收束。每一记敲过的钟都在此有住址——第四口钟悬在梁上的那一刻，你听见的第四个字就是你自己。
body.en: The terminal hall where every resonance comes home. Every toll has an address here — when the fourth bell hangs from the beam, the fourth word you hear is your own.

body.zh: 「世界在你第一次呼吸前就已经停住了——你听得到的，是它无法收回的遗言。」休垒崖下，E 触碰。
body.en: “The world had already stopped before your first breath — what you hear is the last word it couldn’t take back.” Beneath the Resthold cliffs. E to touch.

body.zh: 「山下那座墓碑无名无姓，只有一道刮痕，横在那里。」——刻痕本身就是答案。
body.en: “Below the hill, a headstone with no name — only a single scrape, laid across the stone.” The mark itself is the answer.

title.zh: 刻痕 · 枝条碑（雾语林）

body.zh: 「雾语林的树不说自己的名字，它们说你的。」鸟从没落过那根枝条——你按 E 的时候，名字先认出的是它。
body.en: “The trees in Whisperwode don’t speak their names — they speak yours.” No bird ever landed on it; when you press E, the name recognizes it first.

title.zh: 刻痕 · 水下钟（沉唱堂）

body.zh: 「水底有一口钟，它从没被响过——水没过它时，人也听不见了。」听不见的东西，其实一直在。
body.en: “At the bottom, a bell never struck. Once water covers it, no one hears it again.” What cannot be heard has never stopped, all along.

title.zh: 刻痕 · 水泡软的字（沉唱堂）

body.zh: 「这一块刻了一行字，但水漫进了字里很久。」拓片之前，先放一段安静。
body.en: “An inscription, one line of characters — but water soaked into the strokes long ago.” Before the rubbing, a season of quiet.

title.zh: 刻痕 · 划痕名册（破拍营地）

body.zh: 「这里所有人都忘了自己叫什么，记得自己的拍子。」雇员名册上全是划痕——名字不要紧，拍子要紧。
body.en: “Everyone here forgot their names. They kept their beats.” A roster of scratches — names didn’t matter; the meter did.

title.zh: 刻痕 · 未敲过的铜块（钟坠院）

body.zh: 「这一口钟从没被敲过，也从没被摘下——它是唯一一块没学会沉默的铜块。」
body.en: “This bell was never struck and never taken down — it’s the only piece of copper that never learned to be silent.”

title.zh: 刻痕 · 知道事的灰（无耳深窖）
title.en: Mark · The Dust That Knows (Earless Deeps)

body.zh: 「井底有一只眼睛——它睁开的那一刻，世界变得比有人在场还安静。」
body.en: “At the bottom, an eye — the moment it opened, the world went quieter than any stage.”

title.zh: 刻痕 · 钟摆银镜（未竟厅）

body.zh: 「时间在这里是一道钟摆，走来走去——就是走不到头。」银镜映见的钟摆，永远差一拍。
body.en: “Time here is a pendulum — it swings back and forth, it never reaches an end.” The pendulum in the mirror is always one beat off.

title.zh: 刻痕 · 带钟的风（风钟海岸）

body.zh: 「海风不会响。它带着一个又一个钟的余温，却从不让你清楚地听到。」
body.en: “The wind never sounds. It carries the warmth of one bell after another, but never lets you hear them clearly.”

body.zh: Tab 开地图；E 休息并保存。调音桩里也住着「手册」和「游记」——这一局的说明书和世界指北针，不挑场合地翻开。
body.en: Tab toggles the map; E rests and saves. The peg also houses the “Manual” and the “Atlas” — this run’s primer and bearing, openable anywhere.

body.zh: 乐章战技页：四个乐章（序句 → 休止），每层按序解锁；研读被动不花资源。乐谱研读 = 学习被动，乐章节点 = 装进主动槽。
body.en: The skill page: four Movesets (Overture → Caesura), unlocked in order; study passives freely. Scriptio = learn passives; chapter nodes slot into active slots.

body.zh: Esc → 调音桩 →「手册」页：上手四键、声音=风险、三场 Boss、结局、卡住怎么办、刻痕说明。玩家不用去看任何项目文档，说明书就是游戏本身的一页。
body.en: Esc → peg → the “Manual” tab: four keys, sound-as-risk, three bosses, endings, stuck-remedies, carved marks. The primer is a page of the game itself; nobody reads the repo docs.

body.zh: Esc → 调音桩 →「游记」页：八区指北针（层数 + boss）、10 处刻痕指路、怎么不迷路、边界之外还没开门的世界。
body.en: Esc → peg → the “Atlas” tab: the eight-reach bearing (level + boss), pointer to all ten marks, wayfinding, and what hasn’t opened beyond the rim.

body.zh: 调音桩前按 E 休息即保存；Boss 倒下自动存档；手动槽可写/可删。档案室（存档界面）不会因为导航按错就吞你的档。
body.en: Resting at a peg saves; boss deaths autosave; manual slots are writable and erasable. The archive never eats your save because you mis-navigated.

body.zh: 教学里捡的「音色石碎料」熔成的石头——每一颗存着一记响过的钟。谱册里的乐章为它们而播，寄存进你体内的每一次共鸣都会自动录入，结束才退回。
body.en: Stones smelted from shards picked up along the way — each stores one toll. The Moves page exists for them; every resonance stored in you is recorded automatically and refunded only at the end.

title.en: EPIC-V “The Age of the Wind-Bells” · DESIGN-ONLY

body.zh: 「敲完之后呢？」——风钟海岸是那一章的舞台：风替你敲第一记、NO 新 NPC、钟楼挂着没有舌的钟。不是胜利，是见证。
body.en: “What happens after you strike?” The stage is Windbell Coast: the wind tolls first, no new NPC, a bell-less bell hangs in the tower. Not victory — witness.

title.en: EPIC-VI “The Age of the Rain-Bells” · DESIGN-ONLY

body.zh: 「雨落到纸上，判词湿了。」——雨书记递来的「沉钟七条罪责」没有署名。带上判词 = 背起一场审判；放下 = 雨停。永远无人作答是谁下的沉钟令。
body.en: “Rain fell on the paper; the indictment stayed wet.” The registrar hands you seven charges with no signature. Carry it = you hold a trial; set it down = the rain stops. No one ever answers who ordered the silencing.

body.zh: 「沉默被产业化了之后。」三幕：低音之城（负荷↓ · 频率↓ · 服从↑ 的计价城邦）/ 霜锤崖（敲钟的人不回看自己的手）/ 回廊钟（你的 48 记编成镇庙编年）。
body.en: “After silence became industry.” Three movements: the Bass Citadel (load↓ · frequency↓ · obedience↑ — a priced metropolis) / Frost-Hammer Cliff (the one who strikes never looks back at their hand) / The Arcade of Bells (your 48 tolls, archived as annals).

body.zh: NEW-LANDS 新陆之一：雨替所有字句签名的谷地。设计稿立场，非本版本 runtime——它是六片新地里唯一以「雨」为题眼的。
body.en: One of the New Lands: the hollow where rain signs every word. Design-draft only, not this build’s runtime — the only one of the six named for rain.

title.zh: 低音之城 The Bass Citadel

body.zh: NEW-LANDS 新陆之一：负荷↓ · 频率↓ · 服从↑。沉默在这里是商品——EPIC-VII 的主舞台。非本版本 runtime。
body.en: One of the New Lands: load↓ · frequency↓ · obedience↑. Silence is merchandise here — the stage of EPIC-VII. Design-draft only.

body.zh: NEW-LANDS 新陆之一：北境冻钟 + 霜锤工坊；锤面硬度由你自己的每一记决定。敲钟的人不回看自己的手。非本版本 runtime。
body.en: One of the New Lands: north-face frozen bells and the frost-hammer works; each strike of yours tunes the head. The one who strikes never looks back at their hand. Design-draft only.

title.zh: 回廊钟 The Arcade of Bells

body.zh: NEW-LANDS 新陆之一：走完回廊，每一记你敲过的钟都有一块石牌——音高 = 该记的实际频率。非本版本 runtime。
body.en: One of the New Lands: every toll you’ve ever struck gets a stone plaque in the arcade, pitched to the true frequency of that moment. Design-draft only.

title.zh: 回声庭园 The Garden of the Return

body.zh: NEW-LANDS 新陆之一 / EPIC-VI 阶段C：EPIC-VI 的伦理终点——玩家不再拯救，只继续走。旧钟主人只说一句：它替你敲过的每一下，都还在回音壁上。
body.en: One of the New Lands / EPIC-VI phase C: the ethical terminus — no more saving, only walking on. The old bell-keeper says one line: everything it tolled for you is still on the echo wall.

body.zh: NEW-LANDS 新陆之一 / 本版本实装：解锁 = flag.organ_gate_open，八地域最后入驻的一片。风不敲、钟不回——它等你去走完余响。
body.en: One of the New Lands / shipped in this build: unlock = flag.organ_gate_open — the last of the eight to open its gates. The wind doesn’t toll, the bell doesn’t answer — it waits for you to walk the coda.
